definitions.rtc_worker_ms: Steady native chunk end-to-end worker elapsed including sensor ROS, model and chunk ROS; bootstrap excluded, drained completed requests retained; mean within episode then mean of five episodes. Parent IPC/poll wait not included.
definitions.hold_fraction: Sum held simulator-control ticks divided by sum all ticks; not mean of per-episode percentages.
definitions.profile_wall: Offline fixed five raw observations repeated five times per block; warmup10 each excluded; before+after50 no-hooks requests are descriptive pooled mean. No camera/physics/ROS during timing.
definitions.profile_stage: Instrumented25 requests. CUDA event elapsed on same stream; includes CPU launch gaps/idle, not GPU kernel busy time. Same-label repeated stage totaled per request before averaging. Inclusive flow includes exclusive action expert, so do not add both.
definitions.a2c2_head_ms: Head computation per episode mean then mean of five episodes; base worker is separate and asynchronous, never add to produce control-period latency.

limitations: One task, fixed five initial states per condition; no general benchmark ranking or statistical superiority claim.
Original E10/P0 and RTC H50/R30 have different schedulers; success differences cannot be attributed to RTC alone.
RTC off/stock/fullVJP use same family-specific weights, initial sensor and initial action chunks; model weights stay frozen.
VLASH uses dedicated pretrained pi05 weights and changes action time origin/query frequency; not direct effect of adding current state to ordinary pi05.
A2C2 uses author450M base, not primary605M SmolVLA; residual/direct semantics unresolved because public checkpoint lacks exact training-source/decode binding.
Early RTC GPU-shared series excluded; clean series coordinated model occupancy and resource monitoring, not hardware-exclusive GPU proof.

SmolVLA/Pi05 profiling has equal H50 and10flowsteps but differing architecture/width/layers/image processing/precision implementations. Localization to action generation is supported; individual architecture causes not isolated.
π0-FAST profiling failed matched output checks and is excluded from this two-model accepted comparison.
